intent: new species in user-confirmed two-pattern world; direct refs are style only

tool_arguments.prompt:
Create ONE new small BACKGROUND ANIMAL PROP for the Num-Num Numbers illustrated world. Apply this same simplified bird-prop treatment to the requested species; it must look like a small cast-world decoration, not a realistic zoological study or detailed natural-history painting. No habitat, water, rocks, grass, ground/shadow disc, clothing, hats, text, labels, watermarks or extra subjects. No photo-real textures, glossy 3D, complex shading or sharp predatory teeth.
